result.title: Towards Faithful Data Selection: Statistical Limits and Scalable Algorithms
result.summary: What does it mean to have an optimal data selection algorithm? Optimality is conventionally framed as finding a subset that minimizes the population error of the classifier trained only on that subset. Our starting point in this work is first to show that this goal is information-theoretically impossible unless the data selection algorithm has access to a validation set order-wise larger than the training set. This impossibility result motivates shifting from unverifiable population risk minimization to a one-sided guarantee that we refer to as faithfulness: for any candidate subset, we provide an estimable proxy that upper-bounds the difference between training on the full training data and on only the subset. We model training with the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm and bound the Kullback--Leibler divergence between subset-trained and full-data-trained parameter distributions by the trajectory-accumulated gradient discrepancy. Minimizing this discrepancy gives a principled way to select a subset. Even though the resulting problem is NP-hard, we propose a swap-based local search that decreases the bound at every accepted step. It can therefore refine the output of any selector without worsening its bound. Finally, we provide experimental results on CIFAR10 and CIFAR100 showing that it matches existing data selection baselines. Implementation of our algorithm and the code for reproducing the results are available at: https://github.com/Mehdi-Inane/data_selection_swap.

AI.brief_summary: 论文先证明「仅在选定子集上训练即最小化总体误差」在信息论上不可行，转而提出 faithfulness 单边保证：以 ULA 训练下子集与全量数据所得参数分布的 KL 散度上界（累计梯度差异）作为可估计代理，并用 swap 局部搜索优化该界，在 CIFAR 上匹配已有数据选择基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「子集训练相对全量训练的分布差异上界」与单调改进的交换搜索，可能可供核查用于 latent 推理轨迹或视觉证据子集的筛选与训练贡献分配；论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，联系需较多核查。
